reviews.shade: MEDIHEAL Rose PDRN Essential Mask Sheet For Healthy Glow 10ea
reviews.text: I love the fact that these came as a part of the MEDIHEAL set. I love a good face mask, and this one feels great on the skin. The rose smell is a little overwhelming if you're not a rose person though.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢啲面膜係以 MEDIHEAL 套裝形式一齊寄到。我好鍾意好嘅面膜，而呢款用落皮膚感覺好好。不過如果你唔係好鍾意玫瑰嘅人，玫瑰味有少少濃烈。

reviews.shade: MEDIHEAL Rose PDRN Essential Mask Sheet For Healthy Glow 10ea
reviews.text: I find this mask quite hydrating, and it does seem to make my skin look a touch brighter. I’ll keep using it to see whether the effects become more noticeable. The sheet is similarly thin and not too sticky, which I really like.
reviews.zh: 我覺得呢款面膜幾保濕，而且好似令皮膚睇落亮咗少少。我會繼續用，睇吓效果會唔會更加明顯。面膜紙都同樣薄，又唔會太黏，我好鍾意。

reviews.shade: MEDIHEAL Rose PDRN Essential Mask Sheet For Healthy Glow 10ea
reviews.text: all mediheal masks seem to leave skin plump and moisturized. i still have to test more to see final results. this is from using twice alone.
reviews.zh: 所有 mediheal 面膜似乎都令皮膚飽滿、滋潤。我仲需要多啲測試，先至睇到最終效果。呢個只係我用咗兩次嘅感受。

reviews.shade: MEDIHEAL Rose PDRN Essential Mask Sheet For Healthy Glow 10ea
reviews.text: Scared to use it because I have sensitive skin.
reviews.zh: 因為我皮膚敏感，所以有啲驚唔敢用。

reviews.shade: MEDIHEAL Rose PDRN Essential Mask Sheet For Healthy Glow 10ea
reviews.text: The mediheal face masks always adhere really well compared to the other brands i have tried. This one has a light rose scent.
reviews.zh: 同我試過嘅其他品牌比較，mediheal 面膜貼服效果一直都好好。呢款有少少玫瑰香味。

reviews.shade: MEDIHEAL Rose PDRN Essential Mask Sheet For Healthy Glow 10ea
reviews.text: There is a reason these are the number one selling ind. masks in Korea! (mediheals) they don’t miss! I use all of their products and they have greatly improved my skin!!!
reviews.zh: 呢啲（mediheal）面膜係韓國銷量第一嘅單片裝面膜，係有原因嘅！佢哋從來唔會令人失望！我用晒佢哋嘅產品，皮膚改善咗好多！！！

I love Number's Inn sheet masks. I love 2.3.5, but I was interested in the renewed No. 1, so I bought 1 as a trial. It seems good to just stick to the serum.
reviews.zh:
Stretch
我好鍾意 Number's Inn 面膜。我好鍾意 2.3.5，但係對改良版 No. 1 有興趣，所以買咗一片試吓。似乎淨係用精華液就已經幾好。

reviews.shade: MEDIHEAL Rose PDRN Essential Mask Sheet For Healthy Glow 10ea
reviews.text: It hydrates deeply, soothes irritation, and brightens my complexion. The lovely rose scent enhances relaxation, making it a luxurious treat for my skin!
reviews.zh: 深層滋潤、舒緩刺激，亦令膚色更亮白。好聞嘅玫瑰香味提升放鬆感，令我嘅皮膚有一次奢華嘅護理享受！
